title: WKAppBot SDK & Harness End-User Deployment Architecture
desc: Mandates sibling directory structure (wkappbot-sdk and wkappbot-kih) under the user's Documents folder. Specifies wkappbot-sdk/bin as the core AppBot folder. Guides AI agents on path resolution for deployment.
steps: 1. SIBLING REQUIREMENT: wkappbot-sdk and wkappbot-kih MUST be deployed as sibling directories inside the exact same parent folder.
2. OS LOCATION: The parent folder MUST be located in the user's OS Documents directory (e.g., C:\Users\<Username>\Documents\ or ~/Documents/).
3. CORE BINARY FOLDER: The user's 'AppBot folder' refers to the wkappbot-sdk/bin directory, which contains the executables.
4. AGENT RULE: All AI agents MUST assume this exact layout for path resolution, configuration, and troubleshooting in end-user environments. Do not assume 'D:\GitHub' for end-users.
author: claude
